purpose: Run the already completed source-blind AI-assisted annotations through the remaining surface comparison and surface-conditioned G1-G4 engineering path without representing them as independent human ground truth or satisfying the frozen human continuation gate.
hash_policy: Normalize UTF-8 CRLF and CR line endings to LF before SHA-256 for tracked text and the blind manifest. Preserve raw artifact-byte hashes already recorded by the deterministic baseline audit.

annotation_policy.annotation_semantics: AI-assisted source-blind preannotation; not human ground truth
annotation_policy.comparison_population: All 36 terminal AI-assisted annotations are retained in status counts. Only the 30 completed annotations enter relation metrics and diagnostic replay; six unassessable packets are reported and skipped.
annotation_policy.reason: The source key remains closed and the result is explicitly diagnostic, so no human-review quality claim or hidden-duplicate agreement is produced.

comparison_metrics.pair_scope: Remove AI-assisted outlier lines, enumerate unordered active-member pairs, compare shared AI-assisted surfaces with shared deterministic subfamilies, and report unassigned pairs as abstentions.
comparison_metrics.aggregation: Report micro confusion counts and macro per-family same-surface retention and different-surface separation.
comparison_metrics.counterfactual_only: Also evaluate the already frozen human continuation thresholds for orientation, but label them counterfactual and never convert their outcome into authorization.

diagnostic_replay.selection: Run all and only reviewer IDs whose AI-assisted annotation status is completed.
inputs: this diagnostic protocol and the validated AI-assisted audit
diagnostic_replay.measurement: Reuse frozen deterministic surface scopes and the frozen G1-G4 implementation. Exclude G5.
diagnostic_replay.failure_rule: Protocol, manifest, agent audit, annotation closure, baseline result, identity, path or implementation drift fails before final diagnostic output is published.
diagnostic_replay.output: Per-packet G1-G4 diagnostics and aggregate availability or finding counts only. No AI score, probability, threshold selection or web artifact.
